Abilities.Name: Aerobraking
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Group in Orbit's activation, that Group may move up to the maximum distance allowed by its Order this activation. At the end of its activation, it is moved into Atmosphere. Ships of L, M, and H Tonnage do not take damage due to Atmosphere this activation. Ships of C Tonnage only take 1D3 damage due to Atmosphere this activation instead.

Abilities.Name: Intensify Point-Defence
Abilities.Effect: At the start of the asset phase, pick one friendly Group. Until the end of the round, Ships in that Group cannot be affected by Saturation Fire and may re-roll Energy and Kinetic saves of a 1 when rolling to save against Torpedoes and Mines.

Abilities.Name: Infiltrate and Sabotage
Abilities.Effect: At the end of the Planning Phase, pick one Dropsite within 6" of a friendly Group. That Dropsite takes D3+1 Core hits.

Abilities.Name: Mass Driver Volley
Abilities.Effect: When you assign a "Mass Driver" Weapon System to targets, that Weapon System improves its Lock by 1 for that attack sequence. If that Weapon System already has a Lock value of 2+, it causes criticals on a result of a 3+ for that attack sequence instead.

Abilities.Name: Atmospheric Bombing Run
Abilities.Effect: At the start of the Asset Phase, target one friendly Wing of Bombers. That Wing reduces its Thrust by 2" and gains the Bombardment special rule until the end of the round.

Abilities.Name: Next-Gen Armour Plating
Abilities.Effect: At the end of the Planning Phase, target one friendly Group. That Group may re-roll failed Energy Saves until the end of the round.

Abilities.Name: Interceptors
Abilities.Effect: When a Wing of enemy Bombers are placed or moved into based contact with a friendly Ship, before they attack, choose a Wing of friendly Fighters within their Thrust of the friendly Ship. Move any number of Fighters from that Wing into base contact with the Friendly Ship, then remove the moved Fighters and that many enemy Bombers. Fighters moved this way cannot ignore intervening Scenery for any reason.

Abilities.Name: Overcharge Lasers
Abilities.Effect: When you assign a Group's weapons to a target, pick one of the attacking Group's Weapon Systems with "Laser" in its name. That Weapon System gains Fusillade-2 for that attack sequence.

Abilities.Name: Push Engines to Max
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, each Ship in it suffers 1 Damage and improves its Thrust by 2" until the end of its activation.
